title: Chapter 572
paragraphs: Chapter 572
Episode 148. Sword Emperor (4)
After Jin and Ron disappeared into the void, the battlefield outside quickly turned grim.
This was because he revealed a power greater than before he was bound by the demonic seal of Hidden Palace.
He judged that all variables that humans could expect had been blocked.
In the battle that continued for a day, the giants couldn't inflict any damage on Gliyak.
From the start, they couldn't even properly attempt to attack as they did in the early stages.
They were unable to deal a fundamental blow, and his energy was becoming stronger, making it hard to even protect their own allies.
He was like a sea, which, no matter how much you cut, eventually returned to its original form.
They couldn't tire him out, and they couldn't spread out the demonic seal again to bind him, so the situation was only getting darker.
Until Ron, Jin, and Dante returned. The only time Gliyak stopped his attack was when Ron was cutting the form of the white stone left in his abyss.
It was only a matter of time before the giants of Zipple, Runcandel, and Hidden Palace fell.
Kelliark was considering retreating, but due to the black sea change that took place all day, even that was unlikely.
In such a situation, Ron returned to the battlefield with the power of Genesis, along with Jin and Dante.
How Ron was able to enter Genesis in such a short time, what happened while he disappeared with Jin.
The giants didn't know, but one thing was clear.
From now on, the fight wouldn't be as unfair as it has been so far.
Gliyak was being hit.
The brilliant sword energy spreading like a whirlwind was protecting Jin and Dante like a barrier.
The energy of chaos couldn't easily approach the protective barrier, much like animals in front of a fire.
"How... What have you done, Ron Hairan."
Gliyak's gloomy voice still carried an energy that could engulf humans in fear just by itself.
However, the giants, no. Even the others on the battlefield who had not yet reached the realm of transcendence felt it.
Fear was seeping out of his voice. Every time Ron swung his sword, Gliyak hesitated.
Gliyak's body was about to be destroyed, almost brushing against the Sword Emperor Castle before it was destroyed, but Ron standing in front of them seemed even bigger to the people.
"That's for me to ask. What have you been up to so far, in my Hairan."
Ooooong-!
Rashid resonated strongly.
The formless sword, the epiphany symbolizing Sword Emperor Ron Hairan.
That sword had been losing its inherent pure form since the start of the Sword Emperor Castle.
As the situation became more difficult, it lost its transparent color and turned ash-gray, and when it fell into the abyss, it was dyed black in chaos and even stabbed its own kin.
Now, the sword energy starting to pour from Rashid was formless again.
However, the reason his sword energy is invisible is not simply because his sword is technically great as before.
Just as those who have not ascended to Genesis cannot perceive the light of Genesis, the same was true for Ron's new formless sword.
Therefore, the current formless sword is just an invisible sword energy for the absolute majority of humans.
To someone like Chiron Runcandel, it would appear as a sword that couldn't shine brighter... and Gliyak was also seeing it that way.
Gliyak was flinching in a flash so bright it could blind him. Just confronting it felt like his whole body was being torn apart and would disappear somewhere.
"Answer me."
Ron said, looking at Gliyak. Then, at his will, the sword energy of Genesis rushed into his flesh.
[Kaaaak...!]
Gliyak writhed in pain, screaming. The formless sword energy was breaking down the chaos that formed him into particles.
A silent storm.
Those who knew Ron's formless sword could only think of such a strange expression.
A vast power like a flood was tearing him apart, but they couldn't see that power at all.
Even the giants couldn't accurately perceive how the formless sword energy was flowing.
"It seems you have no intention of speaking. Then, let me recite it for you."
Squeak-!
About six of Gliyak's arms, which he reflexively stretched out at Ron's directly swung sword, were cut off.

"White stone, Gliyak. You destroyed the territory of Hairan, made it impossible for people to live on this land again, and tried to kill the cowherd of Hairan. As the Lord of the Sword Emperor Castle, I will question your crime and execute the punishment."
The punishment is, extinction.
Ron's eyes glowed as he finished his words.
And in Gliyak's scream, there was a mix of laughter. A scream that shook the heavens and earth and a cold wind-like ridicule rang out at the same time.
[Puhuhu...! You're indeed impressive. It's clear that you're a more special being than any other human I've met. Let me pay my respects.]
Gliyak, who started to speak, was rapidly shrinking in size. Ron didn't feel any particular emotion at his relaxed appearance.
"But just because you have the power to defy fate... doesn't necessarily mean you can do so."
Whoosh... Gliyak's body began to scatter.
As the unnecessarily massive form disappeared, the chaos lost to the formless sword energy decreased.
Now he was a black wind scattered all over the battlefield.
The giants were still unable to penetrate the chaos and approach where Ron was.
Even though Ron was dealing a fundamental blow to him, the chaos was still overwhelming even for them.
Still, the giants were slowly regaining their calm.
'After all, it would be safer for Ron Hairan to protect the real Runcandel than me... But the question is whether he will protect Jin till the end.'

'Forcing to secure the youngest would rather endanger him. The King of Chaos seems to have some other means left, so it's better to prepare for it. There's nothing I can do to change the fact that Ron Hairan might give up on the youngest.'
Kelliark and Rosa thought.
They were worried about Gliyak's rampage and the possibility of Ron 'giving up Jin.'
The latter seems to be a needless concern, but they had a reason for thinking so.
Although they didn't reach Genesis, they knew well how those who did lost their humanity.
Those who reach Genesis are put at risk of becoming monsters for the rest of their lives.
Especially Rosa had seen what state Chiron was in right after he reached Genesis.
Chiron at the time was no different from a murderer. It was only after a long time that Chiron became as stable and impassive as he is now.
The same could happen to Ron. In fact, as Rosa and Kelliark worried, Ron was still fighting the abyss within him that was trying to erode him.
[Especially if you're like you now, with the emotions of a mortal still strongly remaining...]
Gliyak's voice echoed in the black wind of chaos.
Although he had made a mistake in his calculations and as a result allowed Ron Hairan to ascend to Genesis, he still hadn't given up the possibility that Ron could become his kind.
Perhaps Ron's ascent to Genesis was only a precursor, along with a hunch.

He was also convinced that even if Ron could maintain human emotions, his combat power would surpass Ron's, and he was aware of the fact that the property of Genesis achieved by Ron was specialized in 'protection'.
Whoosh-!
The scattered chaos of Gliyak began to form a vortex in the middle of the battlefield.
At the same time, the chaotic energies that were dyeing the ground began to surge.
It looked as if a black tidal wave was rising from all directions.
Everyone on the battlefield, excluding Ron, was at a loss for words at the sight.
It had been overwhelming enough until now.
However, the energy that Gliyak was beginning to unleash now greatly surpassed the power humans had experienced.
Gliyak's chaos was blossoming.
That meant he had fully achieved the black sea transformation needed to fight with his inherent power.
Until now, he had been unable to use this power because he was absorbing Jin and blocking those who had entered the abyss.
The origin stone is an object made by combining the true power of all the gods, and even the Demon Clan at its peak met its demise trying to resist this power.
And the kings of the black sea were the ones who divided and possessed this power in five parts.
What has been revealed so far couldn't be all of it.
Since the start of the war, time has never been on the side of humans, even until this very moment.
The approaching giants stopped their charge and took a deep breath. The poison of chaos sprouting from the ground was holding them back.

All other humans couldn't even breathe properly. Even the Black Knights and the wraiths coughed up blood from the chaos infiltrating their bodies, and the knights and mages below them quickly lost consciousness.
Talaris' condition wasn't good either. As she hadn't unlocked Elona's seal, she didn't have the power to protect herself.
The only reason Talaris didn't collapse immediately was because Rosa quickly made a decision and returned to her side.
"Queen of the Secret Garden, come to me."
Rosa remembered that before Jin disappeared, Talaris had tried to tell Kelliark that she had one last trick left.
As Rosa and Kelliark had predicted, Jin and Dante were unaffected by the poison of chaos rising from the ground. It was Ron's power that protected them.
That meant Ron had to continue to protect them while fighting Gliyak.
And Jin, as soon as Gliyak's rampage began, realized that something was wrong with Dante behind her.
'Dante's body... is being eroded by the chaos again...!'
She could see Dante's hand around her neck slowly turning black.
Ron was aware of this and angry, but not enough for Jin to notice.
However, Gliyak knew exactly. He knew that Ron was falling into rage. And that this rage would soon turn into hatred and tempt Ron again.
"Ron Hairan, if you want to defeat me, you should have nothing to protect...."
